item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The remaining leader-election state transitions are consistent with the documented split between BLE’s leader view and the promise state used by Sequence Paxos; no independent correctness issue was established.

The audit remains at 27 confirmed findings. The highest-impact issues are unchanged:

- LFU cache resynchronization causing replica value divergence,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corrupting decided state,
- `AcceptSync` reducing a decided index,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The full report and all retained reproduction artifacts remain available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
